scope: Isolated capability investigation, not a real dispatch or full Phase 1 acceptance run

nativeAddonReproduction.bunResult: child process crashed at unsupported uv_get_osfhandle
nativeAddonReproduction.status: known incompatibility reproduced, not a supported lock implementation

findings.taskReadTransport: TOON; --json supported for mutations, not ordinary reads
findings.holdMapping: indefinite hold, supported body update, reopen to queued; read back each operation
findings.conditionalTaskStart: not available; requires exclusive status mutation as specified by PRD
findings.conditionalLeaseReturn: proved with allocation ID and holder
findings.resultCommitRetention: proved through conditional return and slot reuse
findings.ignoredSeedRetention: not automatic; a modified ignored seed is removed on return despite clean Git status
findings.piSessionStorage: public APIs work under Bun for synthetic records
findings.piMetadataOnlyPersistence: not flushed until a user or assistant message exists
findings.workerRuntimeContract: requires adapter implementation and real worker tests
findings.dispatcherLock: macOS flock proved via experimental Bun FFI; production binding not selected

limitations: No Pi agent or model was launched
No real end-to-end dispatch was performed
No complete dispatcher fault-injection suite exists yet
No host power-loss durability guarantee was tested
Only the selected versions and macOS arm64 host were tested
